title: Hidden sin doesn't stay hidden forever.
paragraphs: Hidden sin doesn't stay hidden forever.
It slowly poisons the heart, hardens the conscience, and destroys what God is trying to build in your life.

Scripture says the one who covers his sins will not prosper — but the one who confesses and forsakes them will find mercy.
(Proverbs 28:13)
Freedom begins with honesty before God.

The sin you're hiding right now…
The one nobody knows about…
That's probably the very thing destroying your peace.

God already sees it anyway.
Confession isn't humiliation — it's the beginning of freedom.
Why do you think people hide sin instead of confessing it?
Fear? Pride? Shame? Or something else?
